title: ai-rulez exposure areas
description: Output of `ai-rulez exposure areas --format json`: the area map as loaded and the area of every artifact of the session inventory, with how it was decided. See docs/exposure.md.

root.description: The absolute repository root, slash separated.

areas_file.description: The areas file the map was read from (--areas or [exposure] areas_file), relative to the root and slash separated, or absolute (slash separated) when it lies outside the root; empty for the inline [exposure] form.

plugins.description: The plugin mode of the inventory.

areas.description: The areas in map order, terms and ambiguous words normalized (trimmed, lowercased, unique, sorted).

scope.description: The directory that owns the artifact; "." for the root.

area_scope.description: The directory whose path claims were tried: the scope, or a plugin skill's plugin directory, relative to the project root of the area map (with --root's path in front when --root lies below it).

counts.description: The number of artifacts per area: every area of the map and unclassified, 0 when no artifact is in it.

problems.description: The inventory's problems: files that could not be read or decoded. An unread artifact is classified on an empty text.
